blocks.text: 1 Samuel 22 contains 23 verses. It opens with: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave of Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him. It concludes with: Abide thou with me, fear not; for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: for with me thou shalt be in safeguard. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: First Samuel moves from Eli's failing priestly house through Samuel's prophetic leadership and Saul's rejected kingship to David's anointing, rise, exile, and Saul's death.
